_about: ScreenGuis of equal and different DisplayOrders, ScreenGuis inside GuiObjects, Enabled and Parent changes (P4d,
LA-NESTED-SG): a 0.747 client (Studio 0.747.0.7471481's client, rendered 1600 x 1000 at 1.5x, two runs
each, identical). Squares R (red, 100, 100), NA (green, 200, 200), B (blue, 300, 300), Y (yellow, 400, 400), 300 x 300;

points (R, N = green, B, Y, bg). Used by native/src/engine/input/tests.rs screen_guis_draw_and_take_input_in_a_clients_order.
